rationale: SUPPRESSED under the M5 Sec 10 trigger 'all accessible pivot tiers SINGLE-SOURCE-INDICATIVE', which the report itself establishes: its Sec 19 states that all daily, weekly and monthly prior-period H/L/C are single-source (close-corroborated only) and that 'every pivot tier is flagged SINGLE-SOURCE INDICATIVE', naming that flag as the contract the strategy layer reads for suppression. Trade 2 draws its entry, stop and every target from pivot tiers, so the trigger fires on the report's own declared evidence state. The report produced the card live anyway, citing a run instruction in Sec 19 and Sec 20 that 'trading strategies are produced despite the reduced pivot-corroboration depth'; a run-time instruction cannot relax a fixed suppression gate, and the compliant output is this row. The test is symmetric: a live card would require the report to name which tier is corroborated and by which second independent source, and it names none. Regime and branch, recorded for audit: the regime label is TRANSITION (the report's Sec 9 and Sec 20 both state it; the trend gate fails on a negative VOLator slope -0.08 and the range gate fails on |KER| 0.15 above the 0.13 threshold), so the only permitted Trade 2 branch was the breakout side, long, with entry above daily R1 and no counter-side limit. Reference close 7,574.20 (Fri 2026-07-10 cash session, 16:30-23:00 broker, from the slice); ATR14 82.99 on that same cash-session basis (88.12 on full broker-day bars). Daily pivots from the D-1 session H 7,579.50 / L 7,505.60 / C 7,574.20 by P=(H+L+C)/3, R1=2P-L, R2=P+(H-L), R3=H+2(P-L), S1=2P-H: P 7,553.10, R1 7,600.60, R2 7,627.00, R3 7,674.50, S1 7,526.70. For the record of what the published card got wrong independently of the gate: its trigger 7,577.84 was the midpoint of the stale D-2 R1/R2 pair, its TP1 was set to that same 7,577.84 so the first target equalled the entry trigger (the static DUD_TP1_SIDE the QA review found), its cited 'break above daily R1 7,566.44' sat below the D-1 close so there was nothing to break, and its stop used the trend-branch formula in a transition regime. Building the card strictly to the rule does not mean repairing that ladder: the gate fires first, and a suppressed card is a row, not a card, so no entry, stop, R or target is carried here. No arming level is offered either, because the gate is an evidence-corroboration test, not a price test - it clears only when a second independent source corroborates a prior-period high/low, never by price moving. No fib level is involved: the Trade 2 breakout branch is built from pivot tiers only.
